transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just struggling a bit. I came in because I keep feeling like I’ve let my family down... with this mortgage we took on. And then at work, every small mistake just... I don't know. It just proves I’m useless. Like I deserve whatever happens to me.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while. I guess... maybe a year and eight months? It started after I took on the mortgage for the condo.
During this time, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?
I don't know... I guess I just go to work and come home. There's not really much else I do anyway.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about several different areas of your life, even when there is no immediate problem?
Um... no, not really. I mostly just... think about the mortgage. And work. I don't really worry about other things if... if there's no reason to.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt sad, down, or hopeless most of the day on most days?

Yeah... I suppose so. It's mostly just... this heavy feeling. Like my chest is just empty most days. When I'm at work, carrying plates and stuff... I just go through the motions. I smile because I'm supposed to for the customers, but... I don't really feel anything good.
Do you feel depressed even when you are not thinking about the mortgage or work?

Yeah... I suppose. It's not really about the bills or the restaurant. Just... for most of this whole time, even if I have a lighter day, I still just feel weighed down by it. That empty feeling. And... just feeling guilty, I guess. It's there more often than not, no matter what I'm thinking about.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you normally enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. I mean... I used to joke around with the regulars at work. But lately, I just... keep a straight face. I only say what I have to. And... my brother texts me after my shifts, but I just let the messages sit. I don't really feel the... the pull to answer him anymore. So... yeah.
How has your energy been during this period?
My energy? I don't know... it's fine, I guess. I still go to work. I'm just... tired. But who isn't?
Have you had any thoughts about dying or hurting yourself?

No... not really. I mean, I don't have a plan or anything like that. Just... sometimes, when I can't sleep before an early shift, I just kind of think... maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. Then I wouldn't have to keep... messing everything up. But I wouldn't actually do anything.
How has your sleep been during this period?
It's... I don't know. Fine, I guess. I mean, I mentioned I can't sleep sometimes before an early shift. But... it's just normal sleep, I suppose. Nothing really to say about it.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to do your work and manage your usual daily responsibilities?

It's... I don't know. I guess it's been a little harder lately. I've almost missed a few shifts. And... I messed up some mortgage paperwork recently. At work, I'm just... having more trouble keeping up with the POS reports and the inventory stuff. It's... I worry I might get fired, and then... I don't know what I'd do about the condo. I guess I've been keeping to myself more, too. My brother and some people at work... they've said I don't seem like myself. But... I'm still getting by, I suppose.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite during this period?

I guess... it's been a bit all over the place. Some weeks I don't really touch the staff meal. And then... I don't know, other nights I'll get back to the condo and just eat whatever's in the kitchen. Just to... feel settled, I suppose. But it's nothing major.
During these past year and eight months, have you had a period of at least two months when you felt mostly back to your usual self?

I don't think so. No... not for two months. Even on the days that aren't so bad, I just... I still feel heavy. Like there's this empty, guilty feeling that's just always there, most of the time anyway. It hasn't really gone away.
